title: Would — würde, hätte, wäre, and Six Lines
label: ch:ge-would
canDo: I can say what would happen with würde, hätte, wäre and könnte, and write six connected lines about a trip that end on a condition.

payoff.summary: Complete GE-W261-sechs-zeilen: six lines to one reader about a trip, events in order in the past, a reason, a feeling, and a last line with wenn and the Konjunktiv II.
